hypothesis_status_before_timing: CPU qualification showed gains; the short TPU qualification showed near parity for joint and slower cached sequential/behavior. This fixed four-repetition screen retains negative results and diagnoses costs.
limitations: Fixed weak 9x9 model, float32/highest execution, no MCTS or training.
First timing stream extends the short qualification stream; the next three streams and all four orders are fixed before launch.
Initial zero carry allocation is charged to compilation/warmup; final retained outputs are drained inside every timed loop.
Dense retained-array logical byte volume is not measured HBM traffic. Compiler FLOPs and profile module residency do not establish MFU.
Known-policy mode shares both actual policy draws. Learned behavior has less information.
A cached gain versus its own full-prefix mode must also be compared with cached sequential before crediting speculative execution.
Cold canonical-history reconstruction tests are not distributed cached-rollout checkpoint recovery.
order_balance: Each cached mode precedes its same-mode full-prefix control twice and follows it twice.

primary_speed_criterion.metric: Complete equal-work packet-loop wall time, using the slowest host per mode.

stopping_rule: One attempt. Any event/state or cache-metadata mismatch, process failure or budget excess prevents speed promotion. Preserve all evidence.
